name: Sika® Foam Backer Rod Closed Cell

cl.x: Provide Sika® Foam Backer Rod Closed Cell where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (July 2025, Version 01.03).

Sika® Foam Backer Rod Closed Cell is manufactured from closed cell, low density, polyethylene foam. Sika® Foam Backer Rod Closed Cell has excellent compression and recovery properties, is available in various sizes and lengths. The round profile assists in providing the correct joint sealant profile allowing optimum movement capability.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: Sika® Foam Backer Rod Closed Cell is used as a backing rod for horiontal and vertical expansion joints placed prior to the application of sealants. Sika® Foam Backer Rod Closed Cell provides bond breaking, assists in the control of joint depths for correct joint design, allows for proper sealant tooling, improves contact with joint flanks and reducing sealant consumption.
